about: ZenEng v126, Window 146 (fix 470): the content judge of record. score = intercept + sum over measures of weight * (value - mean) / sd; a measure a window lacks takes fill_missing_with. Read on the first eight bars of the first verse and of the first chorus; a build's content score is read as the v108 judge's was. The four new measures are computed by cand() in zeneng_v121_blind_spots.json; the chord-tone measures and the rest by the judge's own measure code. The order judge of zeneng_v108_judges.json is unchanged.
